messages.content: Who invented the theory of relativity and in which year?

function.name: science_history_get_invention
function.description: Retrieve the inventor and year of invention based on the invention's name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

want_year.description: Return the year of invention if set to true.

message.reasoning: The user asks: "Who invented the theory of relativity and in which year?" We need to answer: Albert Einstein invented the theory of relativity; the year is 1905 (special relativity) or 1915 (general relativity). The question likely refers to the general theory of relativity? But the phrase "theory of relativity" could refer to special relativity first published in 1905. The user didn't specify special or general. We can mention both: Einstein introduced special relativity in 1905, general relativity in 1915. The user asked "who invented the theory of relativity and in which year?" So we should answer: Albert Einstein invented it; he published the special theory in 1905, and the general theory in 1915. The user might want the year of invention: 1905. Let's provide that. Also we can use the function to retrieve the year. The function expects an invention_name and want_year. We can call the function with invention_name="Theory of Relativity" and want_year=true. That will return the year. Then we can answer. Let's do that.
